texas.name: Texas
texas.seoTitle: Psychological thrillers set in Texas | AJ Ghost
texas.seoDescription: Texas pages for Houston, Dallas, and Austin. Each has its own introduction, a free in-page story, and HUNTED free on BookFunnel.
texas.intro: Texas is large enough that a night in Houston does not feel like a night in Dallas, and neither of them feels like Austin when the rain sits on the highway. This directory is the state shelf for AJ Ghost's psychological thrillers in The Ryan Kane Series. Each city page below carries its own introduction, written for that place, and then embeds one of the five free short stories. The story itself keeps a single canonical home under free reads, so a city page can talk about local roads without pretending the fiction was rewritten for every exit. HUNTED, the Book 1 prequel, is free on BookFunnel from every Texas page. Fractured Ground is the Kindle novel. Digital Ascent is the advance copy of book three. Pages appear on their publish date. A city that is only scheduled does not show up here yet. Start with the city you actually drive, not with a generic list that could belong to any state.
